reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Pure Mineral Relief Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: As expected with mineral sunscreen, this does leave a hint of white cast, it leaves purple-like color under my tan/yellow skin. It doesn’t sting my eyes so that’s a plus and sits okay with makeup. It does somewhat leave greasy feeling especially since i have oily skin. It doesn’t peel. Initially it has an odd chemical smell to it but it doesn’t linger. Compared to other mineral sunscreen i would give it 5/5.
reviews.zh: 同礦物防曬預期一樣，呢款用完的確會有少許泛白，喺我嘅小麥／偏黃皮膚上面會變成偏紫色嘅色調。唔會拮眼係一個加分位，同化妝品都夾得唔錯。係會有少少油笠嘅感覺，尤其係我係油性肌嘅情況下。唔會甩碎屑。一開始有陣怪怪嘅化學味，不過唔會停留好耐。比起其他礦物防曬，我會俾 5/5 分。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Pure Mineral Relief Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: So far this is the best mineral sunscreen I have ever used! I love the natural finish it leaves. There is no white cast once it absorbs properly, and it doesn’t take long at all to absorb. It also doesn’t burn my eyes like most other sunscreens do. I am using the mineral sunscreen since it’s the most pregnancy-safe option I found, and I’m happy with this decision and will continue to use it post-pregnancy!
reviews.zh: 暫時呢款係我用過最好嘅礦物防曬！好鍾意佢俾到嘅自然妝效。當皮膚完全吸收之後就唔會泛白，而且吸收速度好快。亦都唔會好似其他大部份防曬咁拮眼。我揀礦物防曬係因為佢係我搵到最安全嘅懷孕期用嘅選擇，我好滿意呢個決定，產後都會繼續用！

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Pure Mineral Relief Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: A gentle mineral sunscreen with broad-spectrum SPF50+/PA++++ protection that’s great for daily wear, especially on sensitive skin. It uses zinc oxide as its main UV filter (physical sunscreen), and includes black rice extract, niacinamide, ceramides, and hyaluronic acid for hydration, soothing, and antioxidant support. The texture is lightweight and non-greasy, but may leave a slight white cast on some skin tones — so blend well during application. Overall a solid choice if you want strong SPF with skin-care benefits.
reviews.zh: 一支溫和嘅礦物防曬，擁有廣譜 SPF50+/PA++++ 防護，適合日常使用，尤其適合敏感肌。主要 UV 過濾成分係氧化鋅（物理性防曬），仲加入黑米萃取、煙酰胺、神經酰胺同透明質酸，做到保濕、舒緩同抗氧化嘅功效。質地輕盈唔油笠，但係喺某啲膚色上面可能會有少許泛白——所以塗嘅時候要慢慢推開。整體嚟講，如果你想要高 SPF 又要護膚功效嘅話，係一個唔錯嘅選擇。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Pure Mineral Relief Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: I have used for almost a year now, daily, multiple times on sunny summer days. It layers nicely, and sits perfectly under makeup. My favorite part is that it is a mineral sunscreen rather than a chemical, I think it is gentle on my face, which can be sensitive due to my retinol. Doesn’t break me out or clog my pores. It does have a white cast, but once it is completely dry you can’t see it at all! It’s very faint while it is drying.
reviews.zh: 我已經用咗差唔多一年，每日都用，夏天大太陽更加會重複塗幾層。疊加起嚟好順，喺妝前打底完全無問題。最鍾意嘅係佢係礦物防曬而唔係化學防曬，搽上面對皮膚好溫和，因為我有用 Retinol 皮膚有時會比較敏感。唔會令我爆瘡或者塞毛孔。的確係有泛白嘅情況，不過完全乾透之後就睇唔到！等待期間泛白都好輕微。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Pure Mineral Relief Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: This is my second one of this sunscreen, I absolutely love it! Great for my oily t zone and for my dryer areas and makeup sits so nicely on top aswell, I find my large pore areas look less noticeable like they have been blured with or without makeup and this does not irate my skin as very sensitive even though you have to work it into the skin which is normal for mineral sunscreens
reviews.zh: 已經係我第二支呢款防曬，絕對係大愛！對我嘅 T 字位出油同較乾嘅位置都好啱用，後續上妝都好貼服。我發現有毛孔粗大問題嘅位置望落冇咁明顯，好似被柔焦咗，無論有冇化妝都一樣，而且我皮膚好敏感都唔會被佢刺激到，雖然要慢慢推開先至推得均勻，但呢個係礦物防曬嘅正常情況。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Pure Mineral Relief Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Great! A few pointers… I have darker skin and it did in fact leave a white cast even after rubbing it in for a while. On top of that it also started pilling a lot. It did sit well under makeup and did leave a velvet finish though.
reviews.zh: 整體唔錯！幾點要留意……我膚色比較深，用完之後即使搓勻咗一陣都仍然有泛白嘅情況。而且仲會嚴重起擦膠碎。雖然係咁，喺妝前打底效果都唔錯，仲有絲絨妝效。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Pure Mineral Relief Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text:
I have oily skin and needed something that wouldn't add to that and break me out~ this is working amazingly so far.
It absorbs really fast and leaves your skin feeling hydrated, it does leave a little white cast though (it doesn't show so well on camera) but its minimal enough (and im pale enough) that it doesn't bother me at all.
reviews.zh:
我係油性肌，需要一樣唔會加重油光同令我爆瘡嘅防曬～用咗一陣覺得非常出色。
吸收得好快，用完皮膚感覺到保濕，不過會留少少泛白（鏡頭影出嚟冇咁明顯），但程度好輕（加上我膚色夠白），所以完全唔困擾我。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Black Rice Pure Mineral Relief Daily Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: I'm sensitive to most sunscreens but not this one! I'm really happy I found a sunscreen that I can use and it feels good for my skin too. Just note that it does leave a white cast and this white cast takes some time to absorb - I have a light to medium skin tone but on darker skin tones the white cast will be more apparent.
reviews.zh: 我對大部分防曬都會敏感，但呢隻唔會！好開心終於搵到一隻我用得到、對皮膚又舒服嘅防曬。注意佢係會泛白，而且需要啲時間先吸收到——我膚色偏白到中等，但喺深色膚色上面泛白會更加明顯。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
